topic: Endless cardio vs lifting for fat loss

scenes.text: Endless fucking cardio, and still skinny-fat? Stop.
Hours on the treadmill, soaked in sweat, and you look exactly the fucking same.
Lift heavy as fuck, three times a week. Squats, bench, rows, presses. Muscle changes your shape.
Then walk every fucking day, and eat real protein at every single meal.
Lift first. Cardio second. That's how you fucking lean out.

caption: Endless cardio and still skinny-fat? Lift first: train with weights 3x a week, walk every day, and eat protein at every meal. Cardio is a bonus, not the plan. Save this for your next gym day.
tiktok_title: Endless cardio? Still skinny-fat? Lift first.
